scenes.line1: How do you test smarter in Python?
scenes.say: How do you make sure your Python tests cover every case, and actually check all your code?

scenes.label: Parametrize
scenes.sub: Run one test with many input sets at once.
scenes.say: Parametrize in pytest lets you run the same test with different inputs, so you cover more ground with less code.
Here, the test runs twice, once for each set of numbers. Parametrize makes it easy to check lots of cases.

scenes.title: Measuring Test Coverage
scenes.say: Coverage tools like pytest-cov show what percent of your code the tests actually run. Aim for high coverage to catch bugs.

scenes.question: Does parametrize increase coverage?
scenes.right: It helps, but only if your tests reach all code paths.
scenes.say: Be careful: parametrize helps, but if your test cases miss a branch, coverage won't be complete.
